aiDescription: Adds 121 new sprites that allow players to recolor ships like Odyssey, Paragon, and Eagle using 15 hull livery hullmods. It also enables enemy ships to use these liveries so that different variants of the same ship look distinct. The sprites are generated using AI tools and hand-finished to enhance lighting and polish.
